data.description: Brandon, testing the restyled build: 'The Accessibility setting doesn't detect when I grant the permission' and 'When I try to turn on the Input Monitoring setting, EasyVox doesn't show in the list'. Settings › Permissions read the permissions only when it redrew, and EasyVox never asked macOS for Input Monitoring (only preflighted), so it never entered that list. Fix: Settings watches the permissions like the setup window (shared code), Input Monitoring is asked for (prompt, then System Settings), and right ⌥ starts working once it's allowed.
data.title: Permissions: Settings watches them live; ask for Input Monitoring so EasyVox appears in its list
